title: Design an authorized dynamic agency monthly summary report
description: A customer-service user chooses monthly service-fee evidence fields and existing customer, currency and statement-date filters in the monthly-summary workspace, then previews the selected columns. Add a finite field catalog and bounded request/response DTOs in the existing ERP layers; reuse ERP-180 scoped AgencyServiceFeeMonthlySummaryService. Recheck identity, customer menu grant and salesperson data scope on each catalog/preview call; validate unknown or duplicate field keys and page bounds before source reads, fail closed and show a clear UI error. Preserve month, customer and original-currency grouping, status-specific amounts and evidence-only language; OperationLogMiddleware records access. Development only: no schema/migration edits, production SQL or real database execution, arbitrary SQL, business writes, secrets or .env changes, deployment or browser acceptance. Verify focused tests and safe Release build/test.
acceptance_criteria: A finite GET field catalog and bounded POST preview validate selected keys, filters and paging before database reads; unknown keys and unauthorized access fail closed.
Preview projects only selected fields from the ERP-180 authorized monthly-summary page, retaining stable paging, original-currency separation, status-specific amount meaning and empty results.

The existing monthly-summary UI exposes field selection, filters and preview with visible loading, empty and error states; focused tests cover scope, field order, invalid keys, page bounds and mixed currencies, and safe Release build/test passes.
